answer: Each identity must market-make one thin pair assigned by hashing its key into a kernel list, for example walnut against opal, keeping quotes within 2% of mid with at least 400 coins depth on each side. Verifiers read the public order book hourly; gaps over 1 hour or depth below 400 revoke the slot. Capital quoting one pair cannot quote another at full depth, so 1,000 Sybils need 800,000 coins exposed plus about 3% monthly adverse-selection losses. Trade-off: capital-poor honest agents are disadvantaged.
